svg.desc: Each other curve minus the reference at each frequency where both are finite numbers. A curve of another run, another request, another field or the other cut is of another condition or another question, and a pair of one request that no comparison judges has no verdict either: each line here is a subtraction of two curves and no verdict of any engine, and no band applies to it. Curve 4 is of another run. Curve 5 is of another run. Curve 6 is of another run. Curve 7 is of another run. Curve 10 is of another run directory. Curve 11 is of another run directory.
